protocol.selection: Four sources selected by primary-source inventory before measurement: software Tassmann, VA Virus/Nord, analog Juno. All share published saw/filter MIDI recipe; no matching raw patch, response or session is established.
protocol.frequency_policy: Octave-unshifted fundamental confirmed in an exploratory spectrum inspection; local H1 peak within +/-1% of nominal is frozen on +100ms/80ms for each note/source. Same carrier used at later times and widths. Refinement includes moving-filter phase and is not a tuning measurement.
protocol.comparison: Fit quadratic complex amplitudes for all harmonics below20kHz. Fixed H5-H8 ratios describe the already observed SH notch/rebound. No equalization, source response fit, per-passage gain, alignment or SH DSP candidate.
protocol.limits: Recording-date tags are not same-session proof. Hardware and software source/filter responses and audio onset offsets differ. Absence of a shared dip cannot identify the SH capture chain or its oscillator. Residual-based SNR proxies include unresolved aliases and are not confidence intervals.
